title: Ukuzinikela Ngokuzithandela
intro: Ngexesha lovavanyo oluvela kuThixo, umphefumlo wabizwa kwisenzo sokuzinikela ngokupheleleyo. Wakhulela kwilizwe eliyinkqantosi, lo mfanekiso wakhula waba nokholo nomonde. Xa umbono wawuyalela umbingelelo, abazange bagungqe. Ibali labo lilitye lesiseko lokuzinikela.
clues: Ndandiyimpendulo yomthandazo womprofeti omkhulu endandiwulindele ixesha elide.
Mna nomama sashiywa kwintlambo engenanto sinomxhesho weedati namanzi kuphela.
Ndakhula ndaba ngumprofeti owaziwa ngokuba nenyaniso nokuba nomonde.
Ndincedise utata ukuphakamisa iziseko zendlu engcwele enikelwe ku-Allah.
Xa utata wandixelela ngephupha lokundibingelela, ndathi, 'Yenza njengoko uyalelwe.'
U-Allah wakuhlonipha ukuzithoba kwam ngokuthumela inkunzi yegusha evela esibhakabhakeni ukuze indihlawulele.
arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
